trap.label: sujeito do particípio
trap.wrong: Having heard it, the idea was clear.
trap.right: Having heard it, she found the idea clear.
trap.why: O português tolera sujeito diferente. Em inglês o sujeito da oração principal deve ser quem leu.

fix.wrong: Having heard it, the plan was clear.
fix.right: Having heard it, I found the plan clear.
Having been alerted, they stayed calm.

rewrite.prompt: Particípio: “After she had heard it, she agreed.”
Passiva: “After they had been alerted, they stayed calm.”
rewrite.answer: Having been alerted, they stayed calm.

rewrite.prompt: Negativa: “Because she had not heard it, she waited.”
rewrite.answer: Not having heard it, she waited.
